pr_title: Enable more nullable reference types in asn.xslt.
pr_body:
* string and Oid types on Choice can be null.
* Reference types that are `@optional` can be null.

Fixes #33824 

/cc @bartonjs

issue_context.title: Some .xml.cs do not match nullability when re-generated
comments: Yeah, I think now that nullability has made it far enough it means we need to tell the generator that OPTIONAL+reference type means to add the question mark.

review_comments: The `if (!HasExtensions)` on line 36 checks that `Extensions` is not null and > 0.
Why did this need to move out?
Ah, presumably to avoid nullable annotations in the indirect reference it used to have.
Line 688 could potentially assign null to an index in `certBagAttrs`
